title: Hooked on this phenomena
content: Guys, I have been glued to this sub for about a week now. I just find this all so fascinating!!! I have never dreamed of Mallworld but I have had seriously specific, long and detailed premonition dreams that I would know immediately upon waking that the dream was going to happen in real life and sure enough it does sometimes a week later and sometimes a year to the day. I also astral projected as a kid so I get the weird dream things but THIS is like blowing my mind!!!! What are your top theories as to what is going on here??? I need answers!!!!
